tha-ap430:1.1: samattaṃ. [425. Sucintita.] Nagare Haṃsavatiyā ahosiṃ kassako tadā / kasikammena jīvāmi tena posemi dārake. // //
tha-ap430:2.1: Susampannaṃ tadā khettaṃ dhaññaṃ me phalitam ahu / pākakāle ca sampatte evaṃ cintes' ahaṃ tadā: // //
tha-ap430:3.1: Nacchannaṃ nappaṭirūpaṃ jānantassa guṇā*gu*ṇaṃ / yo 'haṃ saṅghe adatvāna aggaṃ bhuñjeyya 'maṃ tadā. // //
tha-ap430:4.1: Ayaṃ Buddho asamasamo battiṃsavaralakkhaṇo / tato pabhāvito saṅgho puññakkhetto anuttaro. // //
tha-ap430:5.1: Tattha dassām' ahaṃ dānaṃ navasassaṃ pure pure / evāhaṃ cintayitvāna haṭṭho pīṇitamānaso. // //
tha-ap430:6.1: Khettato dhaññam āharitvā sambuddham upasaṅkamiṃ / upasaṅkamma sambuddhaṃ lokajeṭṭhaṃ narāsabhaṃ / vanditvā satthuno pāde imaṃ vacanam abraviṃ: // //
tha-ap430:7.1: Navasassañ ca sampannam āyāgo pi ca taṃ mune / anukampam upādāya adhivāsehi cakkhumā. // //
tha-ap430:8.1: Padumuttaro lokavidū āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho / mamaṃ saṅkappam aññāya imaṃ vacanam abraviṃ: // //
tha-ap430:9.1: Cattāro ca paṭipannā cattāro ca phale ṭhitā / esa saṅgho ujubhūto paññā-sīla-samāhito // // Yajantānaṃ manussānaṃ puññapekkhāna pāṇinaṃ /
tha-ap430:10.1: karontaṃ opadhikaṃ puññaṃ saṅghe dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ. // // Tasmiṃ saṅghe ca dātabbaṃ navasassaṃ tathetaraṃ /
tha-ap430:11.1: saṅghato uddisitvāna bhikkhū netvāna saṃ gharaṃ / paṭiyattaṃ ghare yan te bhikkhusaṅghassa dehi tvaṃ' // //
tha-ap430:12.1: Saṅghato uddisitvāna bhikkhū netvāna 'haṃ gharaṃ / yaṃ ghare paṭiyattaṃ me bhikkhusaṅghassa dās' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap430:13.1: Tena kammena sukatena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca / jahitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsam agacch' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap430:14.1: Tattha me sukataṃ vyamhaṃ sovaṇṇaṃ sappabhassaraṃ / saṭṭhiyojanam ubbiddhaṃ tiṃsayojanavitthataṃ. // //
tha-ap430:16.1: Ākiṇṇaṃ bhavanaṃ mayhaṃ nārīgaṇasamākulaṃ / tattha bhutvā pivitvā ca vasāmi Tidase ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap430:17.1: Satānaṃ tīṇikkhattuñ ca devarajjam akārayiṃ / satānaṃ pañcakkhattuñ ca cakkavattī ahos' ahaṃ / padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ gaṇanāto asaṅkhiyaṃ. // //
tha-ap430:18.1: Bhavābhave saṃsaranto labhāmi amitaṃ dhanaṃ / bhoge me ūnatā n' atthi navasassass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap430:19.1: Hatthiyānaṃ assayānaṃ sivikaṃ sandamānikaṃ / labhāmi sabbam ev' etaṃ navasassass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap430:20.1: Navavatthaṃ navaphalaṃ nav' agga-rasa-bhojanaṃ / labhāmi sabbam ev' etaṃ navasassass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap430:21.1: Koseyyakambaliyyāni khomakappāsikāni ca / labhāmi sabbam ev' etaṃ navasassass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap430:22.1: Dāsīgaṇaṃ dāsagaṇaṃ nāriyo ca alaṅkatā / labhāmi . . . pe . . . pe . . . // // Na maṃ
tha-ap430:23.1: sītaṃ vā uṇhaṃ vā pariḷāho na vijjati / atho cetasikaṃ dukkaṃ hadaye me na vijjati. // //
tha-ap430:24.1: Imaṃ khāda imaṃ bhuñja imamhi sayane saya / labhāmi . . . pe . . . pe . . . // // Ayaṃ pacchimako dāni carimo
tha-ap430:25.1: vattate bhavo / ajjāpi deyyadhamme me phalaṃ toseti sabbadā. // //
tha-ap430:26.1: Navasassaṃ daditvāna saṅghe guṇavaruttame / aṭṭhānisaṃse anubhom' kammānucchavike mama. // //
tha-ap430:27.1: Vaṇṇavā yāsavā homi mahābhogo anītiko / mahāpakkho sadā homi abhejjapariso sadā. // //
tha-ap430:28.1: Sabbe mam apacāyanti ye keci paṭhaviṃ-sitā / deyyadhammā ca ye keci pure pure labhām' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap430:29.1: Bhikkhusaṅghassa vā majjhe Buddhaseṭṭhassa sammukhā / sabbe pi samatikkamma denti mayh' eva dāyakā. // //
tha-ap430:30.1: Paṭhamaṃ navasassam hi datvā saṅghe gaṇuttame / imānisaṃse anubhom' navasassass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap430:31.1: Satasahass' ito kappe yaṃ dānam adadiṃ tadā / duggatim nābhijānāmi navasassass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap430:35.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Sucintito thero i. g. a-ti.
